betboom.zh: BETBOOM 的快攻占 50%，高于其他队伍的 26%（28 个枪局）。最常用的爆弹是 A 点警家烟加甜甜圈烟，4 次全赢；Boombl4 是最常摸边的人（5 次）。
betboom.en: BETBOOM hit fast on 50% of their T rounds vs 26% for other teams (28 gun rounds). The go-to execute is A with a CT smoke plus a Donut smoke, 4 times for 4 wins, and Boombl4 is the usual lurker (5).

falcons.zh: Falcons 的拖后进攻占 35%，高于其他队伍的 25%（140 个枪局），节奏偏慢。NiKo 是最常摸边的人，14 次进攻时留在另一侧或远离进攻点。
falcons.en: Falcons go late on 35% of their T rounds against 25% for other teams (140 gun rounds). NiKo is the usual lurker, 14 times on the other side or far from the hit.

g2.zh: G2 最常用的爆弹是 B 点的一道烟加二道烟再配柱子火，5 次全败。
g2.en: G2's go-to execute is B with a short smoke, a long smoke and a pillar molotov: 5 times, 0 rounds won.

legacy.zh: Legacy 的进攻里 latto 是最常摸边的人，9 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
legacy.en: Legacy's usual lurker is latto, 9 times on the other side or far from the hit.

lynn-vision.zh: Lynn Vision 最常用的爆弹是 A 点警家烟加靠墓地一侧的 A 后点火，6 次只赢 2 次。防守端他们有 26% 的枪局选择堆点，其他队伍只有 7%（31 个枪局）。
lynn-vision.en: Lynn Vision's go-to execute is A with a CT smoke and a Back A molotov from the Temple side, 6 times for 2 wins. On CT they stack 26% of rounds against 7% for other teams (31 gun rounds).

m80.zh: M80 进攻 A 点占 64%，B 点 36%（25 个枪局），最常用的爆弹是 A 点警家烟加 VIP 烟，4 次只赢 1 次，Swisher 常摸边（4 次）。CT 默认站 A2 B3，占 25% 的枪局，胜率 88%。
m80.en: M80 send 64% of their T rounds to A and 36% to B (25 gun rounds), and their go-to execute is A with a CT smoke plus a Red room smoke, 4 times for 1 win, with Swisher often the lurker (4). On CT they default to A2 B3 at 20 s, 25% of gun rounds at 88%.

mibr.zh: MIBR 有 58% 的进攻带人摸边，高于其他队伍的 37%（26 个枪局）。最常用的爆弹是 A 点警家烟加靠墓地一侧的 A 后点火，6 次赢 3 次，LNZ 是最常摸边的人（4 次）。
mibr.en: MIBR hit with a lurker on 58% of their T rounds against 37% for other teams (26 gun rounds). Their go-to execute is A with a CT smoke and a Back A molotov from the Temple side, 6 times for 3 wins, and LNZ is the usual lurker (4).

ninjas-in-pyjamas.zh: Ninjas in Pyjamas 的分兵进点占 73%，高于其他队伍的 44%（15 个枪局）。
ninjas-in-pyjamas.en: Ninjas in Pyjamas split their hits 73% of the time, against 44% for other teams (15 gun rounds).

parivision.zh: PARIVISION 最常用的爆弹是 A 点警家烟加靠墓地一侧的 A 后点火，4 次全赢；xiELO 是最常摸边的人（6 次）。
parivision.en: PARIVISION's go-to execute is A with a CT smoke and a Back A molotov from the Temple side, 4 times for 4 wins; xiELO is the usual lurker (6).

the-mongolz.zh: The MongolZ 最常用的爆弹是 B 点的一道烟加二道烟再配柱子火，5 次赢下 4 次。
the-mongolz.en: The MongolZ's go-to execute is B with a short smoke, a long smoke and a pillar molotov, 5 times for 4 wins.
